nom: Clinique All-in-One Cleansing Micellar Milk + Makeup Remover - Very Dry/Dry

avis.texte: I love this product but have a very difficult time getting it out of the bottle. It's thick and creamy…love that…but getting it out is nearly impossible. I was going to give up on this cleanser…I'm waiting for Clinique to make a change! Great product, bad packaging.

The cleanser is mild for my skin. However after the first few uses, it is near impossible to get product out of bottle to use. I have tried leaving it upside down, beat against counter, but no. I feel it is a waste of my money. Will be returning. Please change up the bottle packaging. Disappointed.

avis.titre: Thick and hard to wipe off
avis.texte: I am very disappointed with this product, I was looking for something to remove sunscreen and cleanse my skin. This was so thick that too much product came out when I first opened it. It felt like the product was still on my skin after wiping off so had to use miceller water to remove remaining product, even though it states all in one. After using a few times it is so thick it won't come out of the bottle, it is stuck around the sides of the bottle. An expensive product and not value for money.
Removes my makeup and cleans my face in one step. I have sensitive and dry skin smd had no issues.

My skin feels great. I love that it removes eye makeup. My only complaint and the reason I gave it 4 stars is it is hard to get out of the bottle. I have to keep it upside down and add water as I use it.

avis.titre: My skin feels luxurious and clean too!
avis.texte: I have looked high and low for a facial cleanser that doesn't need to be used with water and that actually does the job of cleaning and does not leave my skin feeling stripped. Well, here it is!! I am so happy with this product because it leaves my dry/combination skin soft and subtle and feeling clean. I do use it as suggested to remove facial makeup, mascara and lip product. I do not have difficulty getting the product out of the bottle. I keep it upside down and shake it before pressing to release the cleanser. I am a huge fan!

I love how it leaves my skin after taking my makeup off and it smells so good it was my first time trying it and it won't be the last and it is much better then the miscellaneous water from Garniere it burns when I use it so I am very happy 😃

I tried out various makeup removers including micellar water, balms, wipes, etc. Nothing worked for me because it either burned my eyes, was oily, was too messy to use or was causing wastage. This one worked the best for me cause it doesnt do any of the issues i listed. A must have!!

I have no clue why the reviews aren't better for this product! Its the best first cleanse+makeup remover all in one. I use this first then wipe it off with a wet makeup eraser cloth. I like the feeling on my skin better then a cleasing balm or oil.

avis.titre: Exactly what I was looking for!!
avis.texte: I'had been using the same face wash for several years and was ready to try something new. It had to be gentle, creamy and strong enough to remove makeup…This IS exactly what I was looking for. I love this product. I will be buying this from now on. You won't be disappointed

If someone is looking for a true micellar water, as in a liquid that can be applied and wiped off with a cotton round, this isn't the product. Calling this 'micellar water' is misleading because it has the texture and consistency of a lotion or moisturizer; not even my daily face wash is this thick. This cannot be applied with a cotton round and can't (or shouldn't be) left on your face without rinsing. This may be more similar to a balm to remove make up
Unfortunately this made me break out in hives and irritated my skin. I have psoriasis and eczema. I used a dime size amount and washed the soap and the next day I had a bunch of break outs. :(

Although I don't like the creamy texture feeling on my fingers as I apply and lather onto my skin, my face loved it. Left my skin feeling so nice and soft. I have a different bottle in this same skincare line and although it says it's mild soap it still makes my skin feel very tight after washing it.
bought this on a whim!!! best makeup remover, even for mascara! i dont mind double cleansing now that is available
Is gentle non irritating. does not remove makeup well. Usually have to wash twice. Would mot buy again.

This is a great item. Why bother putting this on sale though when you hardly ever have it in stock? Every time I get a notice about a sale and I go to this product, it's ALWAYS out of stock! NEVER FAILS, I get heart broken every. single. time! I can't even remember when it was last in stock. Will you give people a rain check on this for the sales price? The reason I as is that It's fair to have sales on products when they're not in stock.

avis.titre: Creamy, soothing cleanser...Very Dry to Dry
avis.texte: "All About Clean™ All-in-One Cleansing Micellar Milk + Makeup Remover" is the creamiest, most soothing cleanser for extra-dry skin...It is THE best!!! At 68, my skin has become decidedly dryer and more sensitive to EVERYTHING. Now I do wear waterproof mascara and must pre-treat the eyes with "Take the Day Off Cleansing Balm". Afterwards, I cleanse with the Micellar Milk cleanser followed by a through rinse and swipe with "Clarifying Lotion #1". As a final act, I apply "Moisture Surge Overnight Mask", "Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream" and then …I am ready for the night. This will be the first winter I get to use this cleanser, but I KNOW it will be extra helpful when dryness will be at its peak. Thank YOU, Clinique, for coming up with this delightful cream cleanser!!!
cleanses and removes eye, lip, and face makeup easily without harming my skin, very comfortable, and feeling so refreshing .
It feels great on your skin, and it cleans well. But, the bottle doesn't specify how much you should use

While it effectively removes light makeup and impurities, it struggles with heavier or waterproof makeup. The milky texture feels gentle on the skin and doesn't leave a greasy residue. However, I found it to be less effective in deep cleansing and purifying the pores compared to other micellar waters. It may work well for those with minimal makeup needs or as a gentle daily cleanser.

I have been using the 3 mini travel bar soaps for over 35 years. The mini bar soap works wonderful with my sensitive skin. This All About Clean is very irritating for rosacea and leaves my skin feeling too dry. Please bring the 3 mini travel bar soaps!!!
Retiring mine, gave it a few tries and I still don't like it. Docent get rid of my makeup.

I double cleanse and use this product as my first step to remove makeup. It work very well! I use my hands in circular motions to really loosen up the makeup. I follow up with the All About Clean extra mild cleanser and 1.0 clarifying lotion. It is a wonderful combo for my very dry combination and sensitive skin! Please don't discontinue this product!

Purchased during the 21day a of beauty sale 50% off. I love it! It removed all of my makeup, I followed up with a hydrating moisturizer. The packaging said to follow up with your 3 step skin routine. I usually wear a medium amount of make up.￼ ( Foundation to balance skin tone￼, blush, bronzer, eyeshadow, regular mascara, no eyeliner was worn at that time and my lipstick had already worn off) I would purchase again at similar price but I must admit that my holy grail is their take the day off cleansing balm!!! That stuff is amazing!!!
By far my favorite cleanser for my extremely sensitive skin. No more red face after cleansing. Moisturizing and softening.

Hands down my favorite go to cleanser! I use the TTDO balm as my first cleanse with makeup and use this (1,2 formula) as my second cleanse. It is so creamy and luxurious feeling. No suds or foaming at all which I love for my dry skin. My skin never feels stripped after this. Just soft. When I'm not wearing makeup I use this as my only cleanse to simply take the dirt and sunscreen off. This is definitely a staple in my skincare routine!

The cleansing that has been unlimited repurchase, super easy to use, the cleansing effect is super good, the skin is cleaned in place, natural white and translucent, Whoever uses it will not regret having it, after using it, it is estimated that he will not choose anything else, my skin is relatively dry, I have been using this for many years, it is very good to use and the improvement effect is obvious.

avis.titre: My favorite facial cleanser of all time!
avis.texte: I've read a lot of reviews and see that many say this product does not work. I use this product every day with a silicone facial scrubber and this takes everything off of my face! After cleansing my face with this product, I wipe my face with a white facial cleansing pad with a small amount of the clinique clarifying lotion #2, and absolutely NO dirt/makeup comes off of my face - as if it's been perfectly cleansed with the facial soap. The pad looks bright white as if it's brand new when I'm finished. I will never use another facial cleanser as long as I live. Very good for sensitive or dry skin! Pair this with the Clinique moisture surge hydrator - your skin will be extremely smooth and hydrated!

As a lifelong Clinique skin type 2, I purchased the 1 & 2 formula with the purple lid. I wouldn't call it a milk but a cream. It does a fantastic job at removing light makeup and sunscreen. If you prefer a sudsy experience you might not like this. I apply a dab the size of a quarter, massage into skin, and then use a warm, wet cloth to remove all traces of cream. I found that using just a warm water rinse left too much of a film. I didn't like this cleanser as an eye makeup remover, but I have TTDO Balm for that job. For my everyday, work-at-home face, this cream cleanser works great, leaving my face completely nourished, never stripped, even if I follow the wash with the 1.0 Clarifying Lotion.
Got makeup of pretty well but it left a greasy film all over my face so I still had to go in with another product, will be returning!

avis.titre: Great cleansing cream if you use it right
avis.texte: This is an amazing product IF you use it right. I slather it on my face and wipe it off with a clean warm wet rag, including my eyes. It wipes absolutely everything off with no dryness. Then, I use my 1.0 alcohol free toner and my skin is ready for my treatments. If you like the sudsy experience this is not for you, but if you skin is dry and sensitive, you'll love it. In fact, changing your cleansing method from water activated face wash to cream cleanser will change the state of your skin (I was taught this by a very good esthetician), and she was absolutely right. I don't think people use this product properly based on reviews, so here's my two cents!
This product does not take off the make up. I have to follow-up with the regular cleanser.

This stuff is absolute garbage. Complete waste of money. It does NOT remove makeup at all. After washing my face with it twice, I was left with makeup still all over my face. I don't even wear heavy makeup; no liquid foundation, eyeliner, or waterproof mascara (I wear non-waterproof). It couldn't even remove my powder, much less anything else. Clinique should be ashamed of itself. I don't know how anyone at that company could possibly use this product and actually think it works. It you go ahead and try it for yourself, just be sure to use a cotton ball with some toner afterwards, and you'll see just how much makeup is still left on your face. At least Ulta has a great return policy.
This is my favorite cleanser/make up remover. I don't use it on my eyes but everywhere else. I wipe it off with a wet cloth and can't believe how much comes off. Plus it smells amazing!

Been desperately looking for a replacement for Comforting Cream Cleanser since it was discontinued. Tried this in the most gentle variation. It still burned my eyes when removing eye makeup. The cleansing balm leaves a cloudy film in my eyes after removing eye makeup, although it doesn't burn. So I am still in search of a non irritating makeup remover that I can use in one step all over my face. PLEASE BRING BACK COMFORTING CREAM CLEANSER, there are no alternatives!

This is creamy, effective at removing makeup, but I don't use waterproof mascara, so I'm not sure how it is on it. I've tried both (because I ordered the wrong one), and I prefer the 1&2 Type better because it fits my skin type, and it's much creamier than the 3&4 type.
Wanted a product that would both clean my oily prone skin and remove my eye makeup. Doesn't take make up off at all! Don't recommend.

Really surprised by how well this works! Very soft and gentle and didn't irritate my dry, as sensitive eyes. I used it with waterproof liner and mascara And it worked just as well as a balm, but didn't feel greasy. Will keep repurchasing!
I like that it wipes on smooth, has no strong fragrance and takes makeup, especially mascara and liner, off without repeated attempts

avis.titre: Does nothing Should be able to choose no star
avis.texte: Does not remove makeup. Does not leave face clean. Need to use other face soap AFTER using this product. Very disappointed and surprised how bad it is.

avis.titre: Not as good as liquid face soap
avis.texte: My entire family fights acne always. This cleanser didn't clean our faces as well as the all-about-clean liquid facial soap which is the ONLY face soap we have used for over 25 years keeping our adult acne clear! Will not buy this or others they sell.

Product is nothing more than milk colored water! Had to really scrub (way too much) to remove makeup and forget about getting the mascara off. It only smears it. Wish I had saved my money and used it on a clinique product that I know works!
I like that it's gentle on the skin but milk is not my fav cleanser texture.

Using this cleanser is like washing your face with lotion! It does not foam or bubble at all. It did not remove my make up and my face did NOT feel clean afterwards. I used my toner right after and a lot of make up was on the cottonball. I tried using this multiple times and never liked the result
Useless greasy product. It did not clean or take off my make up. Very hard to rinse off because it is so greasy.
This cleanser is great. It removes all my make up and makes my skin clean. I like that I can use this to remove and clean my face instead of using 2 products.

This has got be one of the worse skin products I have used in a long time. Does not get makeup off and leaves behind some sort of film on my skin. Overall terrible, terrible product and huge waste of money.

avis.titre: It's a good cleanser for people with acne
avis.texte: Having dry skin makes it hard to find a cleanser that cleans your skin good without drying it out and this cleans it good but it does dry it out a little bit.

This is a nice cleanser. I have very sensitive skin and it was not at all irritating. I agree the packaging is not ideal. For those who have complained about the packaging: (1) store upside down to get the first half of the bottle out; (2) add water to the remaining product, it becomes more of a thick lotion than a cream and easily comes out of the bottle.

avis.titre: All in one cleansing micellar milk + make up remover
avis.texte: Thought I would try a Clinique cleanser. I like the feel of it , however, it does not remove my mascara. I would recommend for just a facial cleanser, but not a makeup remover.

avis.titre: The regular cleanser removes makeup better
avis.texte: This leaves my skin feeling less clean than when I started, and when I use the toner after there is always makeup on the cotton ball—whereas with the regular Clinique cleanser the cotton ball is always clean afterwards. Save yourself some time and money and skip this one.

avis.titre: A staple in winter skin care routine!
avis.texte: This is the only cleanser that removes my makeup and sunscreen entirely and leaves my skin hydrated and comfortable. I massage it over my face then gently remove with warm wash cloth. Love it!

I really like the light creamy consistency of this milk. I am a big believer in the double cleanse process and I use this first to get all my makeup off with a cotton pad. Then I wash my face with the all about face wash mild. My face feels super soft afterwards and ready for Clarifying lotion 2 and DDML. My favorite part about the milk is that when you spread it over your face it turns into a very light almost oil like cream, but it doesn't feel oily afterwards, just very hydrated! It is much lighter than the balm with the same results and it's perfect for my combination skin.

avis.titre: Not a replacement for the cleansing milk
avis.texte: I have been trying this for awhile because I wanted to give it a fair shot. The cleansing milk was a HG for me and I purchased so many bottles of it. This stuff I will not repurchase. It is nothing like a micellar or cleansing milk product. It is very thick and difficult to get out of the bottle and leaves a greasy feeling on my mostly normal skin. It does an OK job of removing light-weight makeup (all I am wearing nowadays) hence the 2 stars. Clinique, please bring back the real cleansing milk.

I liked the idea of a one step process at the end of the day. Unfortunately this doesn't remove mascara or eye liner very well. Also it is very difficult to get out of the container even though I store it upside down.

Wish the soap and the cleansing micellar milk bottles didn't look so much alike, and I read it a little closer. My mistake was going by the sample bottle, When I looked it up. I seen the All In One Clean and clicked. My mistake.. I kept it for that reason and hey, I've hardly been dissatisfied with any purchase or sample items. Can't say I love this, It's just okay..

This gently removes all my makeup-even my waterproof mascara. I use 2 large cotton ovals. I rub the product in and let it sit for a few seconds. Then, I wipe it off with one oval and repeat the process once more for a total of 2 cotton ovals. I have dry, sensitive skin and products like this are a must.

Very like. There were no particular problems with the skin, but with this soap it seemed to become even smoother. It is consumed very economically. After washing without cream, the skin begins to tighten, with the cream everything is ok. No dryness, no fat content, no rashes during use (three weeks) did not appear. There are a few black dots on the nose, they have become smaller.

avis.titre: I don't know what this is ...
avis.texte: I tried the sample of the micellar milk for skin types 3,4 at Ulta. It took off makeup I was testing on my hand beautifully. I bought it with the intentions of using it as a first step oil cleanser. It melts down to an oil consistency but it felt like burning on my face. so sad ... I have no allergies and do not have sensitive kin .. I don't know what gives but I wanted to love it so badly. The creaminess is a dream but I can't wash my face with a product that burns.

avis.titre: A lot left in the bottle.
avis.texte: I like this cleanser a lot, particularly in the morning just to refresh my skin. In fact, I have ordered this twice. The problem is there is a lot left in the bottle that will not come out before it is empty. I even store the bottle upside down, but that doesn't help. I've added water to use as much as possible, but diluting the lotion is not optimal. I will use a different cleanser, but sorry this one is off my list.

I was very excited to try this product. I am sad to say that I am not a fan of this. I feel like it leaves my face oily and it does not do a great job of removing all of my make up. I do have to use an additional make up remover to get all of my mascara off of my face. I also feel like I need to wash my face with my regular Clinique face soap to feel like my face is all the way clean.

avis.titre: The bottle is difficult for dispensing the product
avis.texte: I feel like so much of this product was wasted in the bottle, because I had trouble getting it out, especially at the end. I miss the Take the Day Off Cleansing Milk and found this to be a poor subsitute.

Don't love this at all. I've been double cleansing forever, and only used the take the day away cleansing milk. I always felt like all my makeup and sunscreen came off before I washed my face ( I don't wear a ton of face makeup). Now with this it barely feels like I'm removing makeup at all. It's a really thin consistency and doesn't get milkier with water. So disappointed that the cleansing milk was discontinued. The balm is fine - love it for travel- but the milk was the best for what I needed it for.
I'm using a sample from Clinique，i like it，it is very good，thank you！
I recently purchased this product and I love it! It feels great on my face. Never leaves my face dry. I love the bottle too - very easy to use.
I love how soft this makes my skin. It's simple and quick to use and it removes all my makeup without drying out my face.

avis.titre: Still effective at removing spf & light make up
avis.texte: Not my favorite product for removing makeup. Prefer the oil or balm. When used with a microfiber cloth, it works well.

avis.titre: Bring back Take the Day Off Cleansing Milk please!
avis.texte: I agree with every negative review of this product that has already been posted. This is a terrible dispenser bottle. Bring back Take the Day Off Cleansing Milk please!

Clinique is in true form by discontinuing Take the Day Off Cleansing Milk!! I have used Clinique products for over 40 years since I was a teenager and I have seen many products discontinued but this has to be one of the best products to be discontinued! This Micellar Milk doesn't even come close to the Cleansing Milk. It didn't remove my makeup, it smelled weird, it has a gelatinous consistency and it made my face burn. It's getting so I panic every time I need to buy something from Clinique for fear that it's been discontinued! Clinique, I wish you would consider the feelings of your longtime loyal customers and quit discontinuing products! I have very sensitive skin and really want to continue using Clinique but you make it very difficult by discontinuing products. PLEASE, PLEASE bring back Take the Day Off Cleansing Milk!!!

avis.titre: Absolutely love this cleanser. Worth the try!!!
avis.texte: I have been a purity fan for a very long time. However, my skin has just been so dry that I needed something that was really going to help get the makeup off, and put moisture back into my skin. This product is a winner in my book. So glad I bought it. I will be repurchasing for sure.

I did not care for this product. It felt too greasy after you wash it off your face. Would not recommend unless someone needs a great deal of moisture. I have dry combination skin, so this does not work for me.

I loved the original Clinique Take the Day Off cleansing milk. Something in the new one w/ the Micellar Milk has caused an allergic reaction. I have not changed any other products. I have rosacea and I find my face is burning. :( I miss the old formula:(

avis.titre: I hated this. I won't ever buy it again.
avis.texte: I used this product with cotton balls. I was told I wouldn't have to use water at all. It was TERRIBLE. I will not ever purchase this product again. I went through a half of a bag of cotton balls in one night. I do not recommend this product.

I bought this product to use to remove the small amount of liquid foundation I wear each day and cleanse my skin at the same time. It does not remove my make up, but does an okay job as a gentle facial cleanser.

I have tried multiple different face cleansers and this one is the best I have used! I have bad hormonal acne and this has basically wiped my skin clean of any blemishes! It's a creamy base which makes my skin feel very soft and it feels very light. I actually use it in the shower even though it says to use it on a dry face. After using it I just rinse it off with some of the mild face soap. Fantastic cleanser would highly recommended and I want to buy 10 bottles of this to stock up.

avis.titre: Not a cleanaer in my opinion
avis.texte: This is not at all what I thought unfortunately. It did not remove my eye makeup, left a film of makeup on my face and my skin had little oil beads on it after trying to rinse off. I really don't like this and won't ever buy it again. It's like it reacted poorly with water. So disappointed.
Makes my skin soft and i like it for my dry skin. Doesnt irritate or leave redness. Will buy again

I like this cleanser, but not enough to offset my frustration trying to dispense from this bottle. I think they could repackage it and then I'd recommend it more. Also, I think I prefer the cleansing oil to remove any trace of make-up.

I wanted to love this product, but I didn't. It was very irritating to my eyes and made them burn. It did remove my black eyeliner and mascara more quickly than a micellar water, but it's not worth it due to the eye irritation.

Been using this for a while and for the first time and I like how gently it is on my skin. I am 40yo and I don't have any blemishes or decolorations or even super sensitive skin but I am starting with my fine lines and want to be gentle on my skin. This one surely doesn't perfectly remove my mascaras but it loosens them well enough and then I use the Take the day off eye makeup remover to completely remove my mascaras. I read complainings about this cleanser not cleaning well enough but you are not supposed to feel siper clean if it is intended for dry skin.. if people need a more harsh cleanser then they should use one for normal skin. I will buy this one again and again. Also, I always follow with a cotton ball with toner to removed any trace of foundation that is left on my face and this has always been the case even while using other cleansers.

Since the eye makeup remover lotion was reformulated a very long time ago, I stopped being able to use it.The new ( early 2000's)version burned my eyes, so did Cetaphil cleanser, so you understand how sensitive I am! At that time, I had been using the Comforting Cream Cleanser to take off my face makeup. I then realized that it also made an amazing eye makeup remover, even better than the lotion specifically for eyes, and Cetaphil, because it lifted off waterproof mascara and everything else when just massaged into the eyes and then removed with a wet cotton ball, and the face was tissued off and then gone over with the Mild Clarifying Lotion (only one that was alcohol free and tolerated by my skin, and also discontinued for quite awhile!!). So when I saw this released, I was sure that it was finally the replacement for the long gone Comforting Cream Cleanser. I bought it immediately! Even in the extra mild version, it burned my eyes and didn't remove makeup nearly as well as my old favorite! I know that I am unusually sensitive, but there must be products on the market, especially by Clinique, which was my mother's go to brand, and I was introduced to it when there were virtually no other fragrance free products on the market! News of a bonus week was like a holiday for me! Today there are many FF and "clean" products available across all price categories. However, I still have not been able to find a cream cleanser that removes all makeup without causing irritation or a gre

I am almost 41yo and my skin is pretty good. Nevertheless, I have tried many different cleansers and this one is the best one so far. Like I said my skin doesn't require too much. I don't suffer from acne or have blemishes hence why I need something mild and not too harsh.I found that many of the cleansers I tried before left my skin dry. The creamy texture of this one is perfect! I wipe it off with a warm washcloth and follow with toner. I bought it over the black Friday week so I got a 30% discount and I got the cleaner and the Take the Day Off makeup remover on sale.

I'm only using this as an eye makeup remover, but it works great taking off everything - even waterproof mascara. I took one point of because it says that it's for contact lens wearers, but I wouldn't use this on my eyes with contacts in. You don't want to get this in your eyes.
This product does not in any way remove dirt and oil from your face. It's apparent when I use a cotton ball with my toner. I wouldn't recommend

avis.titre: Not nearly as good as the Take the Day Off Cleansing Milk
avis.texte: I wish Clinique would stop changing and discontinuing products and formulas!!!! This new cleanser is not nearly as good as the Take the Day Off Cleansing Milk. It's not as hydrating and does not remove the make up as well. Someone as Ulta tried to discourage me from getting hooked on Clinique because they always change and/or discontinue their products. So disappointed! Please bring back the Take the Day off Cleansing Milk!!!!!!!!! They also changed the formula on their Naturally Gentle Make up Remover as well. I left a review on this earlier; however, Clinique would not let me leave another one! On to find a new product from possibly a new company. I had not bought Clinique products for many years, but then my friend who sells Clinique got me started on the Moisture Surge and Beyond Perfecting make-up and I ventured out into other products. However, most of them have been discontinued after a short period of time or either they changed the formulations on them and they are not nearly as good as they used to be.

I had hopes this product would work well but it just doesn't cut it for me. I don't wear a lot of makeup and the mascara I use isn't waterproof. This product not only stings my skin, especially the eye area but isn't getting the makeup off even with several applications. I hate to be critical especially since I have used Clinique for over 40 years. This is actually the first time I've left review and am sorry it's not positive.

Clinique has many great products, but this is not it. This product does not remove makeup let alone clean the skin. After messaging this product in and rinsing it off, there is still a lot of makeup left on my face. It leaves my skin feeling oily which is the exact opposite of how I want it to feel being that I have oily combo skin. This product just does not work. I will go back to using the take the day off balm, that I love, along with my cleanser. All in one sounded great but this product just did not deliver.

If all your makeup includes is cheap mascara and brows then yeah this is okay. BUT if you are a cakey makeup person like myself DONT get this, waste of money. You have to use so much product to even attempt to get SOME foundation off. It's horrible don't get this.

avis.titre: Great Makeup Remover for Dry Skin!
avis.texte: I have extremely dry skin, the kind that requires heavy duty gentle care like Pond's Cold Cream to remove makeup and cleanse skin. This means that I can't use anything on my face that is soapy, sudsy òr foamy. If this is you, then this type of product is for you. This is a creamy, lotion type product that you apply a quarter size amount with dry hands on a dry face all over including eyelids. I gently massage the product onto my face and then I use a wet esthetic wipe to remove the product from face while rinsing the wipe as I go. I then follow up with another light wash of a lotion cleanser such as Clinique Liquid Facial Cleanser Extra Mild. My skin is left clean, soft, soothed and dry or taut. I find that this removed all of my makeup, including eyeshadow, mascara, lipstick, etc., without irritation, redness or itching. Highly recommend and I plan to repurchase when my I use up this bottle.
My friend recommended this product to me. I used it one time. It's really good. It's easy to remover my makeup and my skin is soft and clean after washing face with it. I like it.
This product is bad, I mean really bad, doesn't remove makeup at all and it is sticky, greasy..... doesn't feel good on your skin.

Well. I've used this 3 times. It seems as if this burns a little bit but it goes away shortly afterwards. This formula is thick. It feels like it leaves a film behind. I don't mind that too much. I like the squeezy container. I will probably use this up and go for another cleanser. I don't see myself repurchasing. For reference I'm a 45 year old female. Medium neutral skintone. Dry, sensitive, and mild rosacea skin.

I've only been using this for four days now and I'm already obsessed with it! I use it at night in lieu of the liquid facial soap - I had been looking for quite a while for something like this - and after only one usage and less than 24 hours, I could already feel that my skin felt softer, cleaner, and that a stubborn patch of bumps/rough skin that I'd been fighting for months was starting to clear up. So amazed! I personally wipe it across dry skin with a cotton pad and then splash off with water, but it didn't feel heavy/tacky like other supposedly non-rinse micellar products I've used, so I can imagine that in the colder months I might not bother rinsing at all. So far, I'm so happy with this one!

I was looking for a cleanser that was free of SLS and so happy Clinique finally came out with one. Once in a while my perioral dermatitis flares up around my chin and it is VERY stubborn and hard to get rid of. It looks like acne but it burns and peels...it's terrible. Usually I have to go to a dermatologist and take antibiotics to make the dermatitis go away. I started using this gentle cleanser about a week ago and so far I haven't had any flare-ups and my dermatitis looks like it may be healing. I really love how soft this cleanser makes my skin feel after washing. This will definitely be my go to cleanser from now on!

So I want to start off with a caveat...this is a great cleanser, but not so much a makeup remover. I absolutely love using this as my first cleanse on no makeup days, and as my only cleanser in the mornings. I have genuinely dry skin, and if you don't also have dry skin, this may feel heavy for you. For me though? It's refreshing and moisturizing without stripping my skin or irritating my eyes. It's enough to get the residue from the oils I use on my face at night, I really enjoy it. Now as a makeup remover? It has trouble with mascara, so I still prefer to use an oil for that. I can't use an oil everyday though because of my eyes, so I love this for days when I don't wear makeup, which is almost everyday. It's also more hygienic because of the squirt bottle. I seriously enjoy it!

I have been using the Micellar wipes since they first came out and love them. When I saw this new product decided to give it a try. Since I have dry skin I purchased the purple one (which is for combo/dry skin). To use it place a small amount (size of a quarter) in your palm and rub between hands. Apply to your dry face and gently swirl all over. Then either rinse off or use a tissue. It works well to remove makeup and leaves your face soft. However, I do wear a lot of makeup (primer, foundation, blush, bronzer, eye shadow, eye liner, mascara) and it did not remove my mascara. I still had to use the (purple) Take the Day Off to get both the mascara and eye liner completely removed. I also found that the Clarifying Lotion (#2) picked up much more makeup on the cotton pad then it does when I used the wipes to remove my makeup. Although I like the product the wipes work much better at removing all your makeup.

I never used Clinique's previous milk cleanser product, but this is very thick. You need to wipe it with a tissue or cotton round, and follow it with a toner. It will not get your makeup off on its own, but it does leave the skin feeling very moisturized. I don't think I'd repurchase, but it's ok. I don't find the packaging design to be the best, though I love it's recycled. The product is too thick to come out in regular amounts and you have to squeeze it hard. I have trouble gripping, so I do struggle with this. Perhaps a jar would be better.

avis.titre: Great and easy all in one cleanser
avis.texte: Really like this especially when I really a simple morning or bedtime routine. Just a little cleans my whole face and neck. Comes off clean and easily worn a damp washcloth. Leaves my skin clean and soft. Does not strip out my natural moisture. My skin is dry combination, but overproduces oil is it is too stripped of moisture. And doesn't bother my eyes AT ALL, and my eyes are super sensative.

avis.titre: Sits on top of skin; Will be returning
avis.texte: I purchased this after the Clinique Take the Day Off Cleansing Milk was discontinued, hoping it would be a suitable replacement. I've used it three times now, and I don't think there will be a fourth. The product is really thick and creamy, and spreads easily on skin, but does not lather, nor does it feel like it is actually sinking in and cleansing skin. It just sits on top of the skin. No matter how much I rinse/remove the cleanser, it still feels like it's sitting on top of my skin, and it seems to be blocking my moisturizer from sinking into my skin. It leaves my skin feeling almost suffocated, since it is so thick and never seems to come off. After using, my skin does not feel particularly cleansed, nor does it feel refreshed. Sadly disappointed with this product. The hunt for a new cleanser begins again!

avis.titre: Waaayyy better than makeup remover wipes!
avis.texte: This does a terrific job at removing my makeup! I massage it into my face and wipe it off with tissue. Followed by my regular face wash. My clarisonic doesn't show any traces of makeup after using this and my skin feels nice, not dried out.
my mom got this for me and its sooooo bad it stings and irritated my face to not even remove any makeup and I used it with my wash cloth and its stained it even after being washed

avis.titre: Not great at getting off eye makeup
avis.texte: Seems to do a decent job of getting face makeup off (I don't wear much, usually just concealer and setting powder so may not work well with a full makeup face). Doesn't do the trick with eye makeup though. I had to use a cleansing wipe to remove the rest of my eye makeup (non-waterproof mascara and eyeliner). The take off the day cleansing balm works much better.

It takes off some makeup, barely. I still have makeup residue and have to go back in with my purity face wash. Also when I tried it again, with my Clarisonic, it caused my makeup to stain my brush head and won't come out and that had never happened with my normal wash.
